title: Shared definitions of the loam contract

id.description: The ID of a plot, link, or repo: 10 characters from a to z and 2 to 7.

time.description: A UTC time in RFC 3339 format.

changeId.description: The ID of a change. It is also the version of an item.

plotLink.description: A link in a plot object. It has the fields of link, and kind. A path or vault link also has exists.

exists.description: Whether the local path exists. Present for a path or vault link only.

linkKind.description: What a link target is. A path is a local path that no Obsidian vault holds. A vault link is a local path inside a vault.

setup.description: The setup command for worktrees of the repo path. It is left out when empty.

copy.description: Files or globs to copy into each new worktree. It is left out when empty.

after_merge.description: What the app does when a refresh finds that GitHub merged the PR of a worktree of the repo path: ask (the default), remove the worktree, or keep it.

plot.description: The plot object of show, new, set, and edit, and each plot of export.

versions.description: Item to version. Items are name, what, why, where, link:<id>, repo:<id>, and worktree:<id>. A worktree item is 0 until a change sets its goal.

entry.description: A null old means the item is new. A null new means the change removed the item.

undo_of.description: The ID of the change that this change reverted, or null.

base.description: The branch that a new branch started from. It is empty for a branch that existed.

goal.description: One line that says what the worktree is for. It is empty when none is set.

link.description: The link that the work started from, or null.

land.description: A land that waits: for GitHub (an auto merge, or a merge queue), or after a merge, for the panes of the worktree to close. It is left out when no land waits.

worktreeVersion.description: The ID of the change that last set the goal of a worktree, or 0 when no change has set it.

worktreeLink.description: The link of a worktree. It belongs to the worktree, not to the links of the plot.

key.description: The ID of a Linear issue, such as ENG-482. For a GitHub issue, # and the number, such as #57, when the issue is in the repo of origin of the worktree's repo, else owner/repo#57. It is empty for any other link.

link_id.description: The ID of the plot link that the link was copied from. It is empty for a URL that was given directly.

pendingLand.description: The options of a land that waits for GitHub to merge the PR, or for the panes of the worktree to close.

method.description: The merge method. Empty with a merge queue.

landCheck.description: One check of a land. blocks is true when the check stops the land.

name.description: A land of an open PR has the checks from checks to unpushed_commits. A land of a merged PR has work_after_pr only.

missing.description: True when the worktree folder is gone.

changed.description: Files with uncommitted changes, untracked files included.

unpushed.description: Commits of the branch that no remote branch holds.

merged.description: True when the branch holds nothing that merged_into lacks.

merged_into.description: The branch that merged is checked against. It is left out when none is known.

error.description: Why a check failed. It is left out when no check failed.

pr.description: The pull request of the branch from the last refresh, or null. It is null when the stage comes from the local checks after new work on a merged or closed PR.

pr_note.description: Why the ship state is missing or old: the result of the last refresh. Empty after a refresh that got an answer.

pr_checked_at.description: When the ship state came from GitHub. It is left out when GitHub never answered, and with the note gh_missing or gh_signed_out.

compare_url.description: The GitHub compare page of the branch. Only for the stage pushed_no_pr.

stage.description: The one stage of a worktree, from the first rule that matches. Empty when there is nothing to show.

pullRequest.description: A pull request. The fields from behind_base to passed_checks are 0 or empty for a merged or closed PR.

merge_state.description: The mergeStateStatus of GitHub, such as CLEAN, BEHIND, BLOCKED, or DIRTY.

review_decision.description: APPROVED, CHANGES_REQUESTED, or REVIEW_REQUIRED. Empty when the base branch needs no review.

queue_position.description: The place in the merge queue, from 1. 0 out of the queue.

head_oid.description: The commit at the head of the PR.

merged_at.description: Left out when the PR is not merged.

closed_at.description: Left out when the PR is open.

behind_base.description: The commits of the base branch that the head does not have.

approvals.description: The reviewers with write access whose last review approves.

comments.description: The review threads that are not resolved, of the first 100.

failed_checks.description: The failed checks of the first 100 checks.

passed_checks.description: The passed checks of the first 100 checks, in the order of GitHub. A skipped or neutral check passed too, so the list is as long as checks.passed. A cache row from before Loam stored the passed checks gives an empty list until the next refresh. MCP list_worktrees leaves it out.

checkCounts.description: The checks of the head commit. total counts every check. The other counts are of the first 100 checks. A cancelled or stale check counts only in total.

state.description: The summary of GitHub: SUCCESS, FAILURE, ERROR, PENDING, or EXPECTED. Empty when the head has no checks.

waiting.description: The checks that wait for a person, such as a workflow that needs approval.

required.description: The checks that the base branch needs to pass before a merge.

check.description: One check of the head commit of a PR, a failed one or a passed one.

name.description: A GitHub Actions job has its workflow name first, such as lint / swiftformat.

url.description: The page of the check, with its log.

duration.description: The run time in seconds. 0 when GitHub gives no start or end.

required.description: True when the base branch needs the check to pass before a merge.

run_id.description: The GitHub Actions run of the check, which loam worktree rerun runs again. It is left out for a check that is not a job of GitHub Actions.

runState.description: Where a run is. shaping, stopped, and limited need you. shipping passed its gate and waits for its PR and CI. ready waits for you to land it.

runCheck.description: A Done when check: a shell command that passes when it exits 0 in the folder of the run.

runSource.description: The issue that a run started from.

worktree_id.description: The worktree of the run. It can be gone. It is empty for a run in a repo folder.

tries.description: How many times the gate or CI failed.

source.description: It is left out when the run has no issue.

pr.description: The PR that Loam opened for the run. It is left out before the run ships.

shape.description: The draft of a run that started in Shaping (loam run shape). It is left out for a run that loam run start started.

session_id.description: The Claude Code session of the run. It is empty until the session starts.

note.description: Why the run is in its state, such as the failed checks.

assumptions.description: The choices that Claude made and the issue does not settle.

answer.description: What you want instead, or empty when you keep the assumption.

plan.description: The steps that Claude means to take.

size.description: Claude's estimate of the change, in one sentence.

drafted_at.description: When Claude finished the last draft. It is left out while the run has no draft: Claude drafts it, or the draft failed and the note says why.

repo.description: The repo of the run, as loam run start --repo takes it.

base.description: The branch that the worktree's branch starts from, or empty for the default branch of origin.

link.description: The link that the work starts from, as loam run start --link takes it, or empty.

model.description: The Claude model of the draft and of the session, or empty for the Claude Code setting.

brief.description: What Claude drafts from when the run has no issue, such as the prompt of a recurring run. It is left out when it is empty.

recurring.description: A run that starts on a timetable (loam recurring add).

prompt.description: What Claude does: the goal of a chore, or the brief of a Shape run.

kind.description: shape: Claude drafts a run for you to approve. chore: a run starts and works to its gate.

days.description: The days of the week, in the order of the week.

at.description: The time of day, HH:MM, on the clock of the Mac.

precheck.description: A shell command in the repo. The run starts only when it exits 0. Empty starts the run each time.

if_asleep.description: once: a time that the Mac slept through runs once when it wakes. skip: it is skipped.

repo.description: The repo of the runs, by ID or path, or empty for the main repo.

last_at.description: When a tick last took it. It is left out before the first time.

last_note.description: What the last tick did, for a person to read.

last_run_id.description: The last run that it started or skipped, or empty.

rule.description: A check that every run of a plot must pass (loam rule add). The gate runs it as the check Rule: <name>.

command.description: A shell command in the folder of the run. The rule holds when it exits 0.

note.description: The note that the rule came from, or empty.

ruleOffer.description: A note that you sent back is like a note that you sent back on another run of the plot, so it can become a rule.

note.description: The text of the note, without its file and line.

earlier.description: The text of the note like it.

recurringResult.description: What a tick did with one recurring run.

run.description: The run that the tick started or skipped. It is left out when the tick made none, such as when the last run has not ended.

kind.description: state: the new state. try: a failed gate or CI, with its note. check: the result of one check. linear: what Loam did to the Linear issue of the run. ship: a push or a PR. ci: the result of CI on the PR. review: your notes went back to the session. note: one of those notes, as <file> line <n>: <text> or as text alone. land: a merge of the PR, or where it waits. shape: a draft by Claude, or why it failed.

connected.description: True when a key is stored.

viewer.description: The person of the key. It is null with no key, or when Linear did not answer.

error.description: Why Linear did not answer a stored key, or empty.
